A.name: A: Lock early
A.description: Buy the whole Treasury ladder in 2027 (top up with 2028 money if needed).

B.name: B: Staged hedge
B.description: Hedge 50% in 2027 rising to 100% by 2031; lock 100% early once assets reach 125% of the reserve cost.

C60.name: C: Build in 2033 (60/40)
C60.description: Balanced 60/40 portfolio until 2033, then buy the ladder.

C80.name: C: Build in 2033 (80/20)
C80.description: Growth 80/20 portfolio until 2033, then buy the ladder.
